locations.name: Bar Espanya
locations.description: Old-school pintxos counter on Carrer de Can Escursac — pintxos stacked on the bar in limited supply (arrive early for the best pick), plus patatas bravas with sobrassada and croquettes. A second location in Sa Gerreria adds terrace seating. The quick, cheap, standing counter stop of a Palma tapas crawl.
locations.address: Carrer de Can Escursac, 12, 07001 Palma, Illes Balears, Spain

references.note: Pintxos stacked on the counter (limited supply — arrive early); patatas bravas with sobrassada, homemade tortillas, croquettes. Second location in Sa Gerreria with terrace.

locations.name: Mercat de l'Olivar
locations.description: Palma's big covered market since the 1950s — Balearic cheeses, olives, local salts, plus eat-in stalls: Mercat Negre for fresh-seafood small plates and Buades for ibérico ham and charcuterie. Quick-lunch counterpart to Santa Catalina Market on the other side of the center — and the meeting point where the Cooking Class Soqueta market tour begins.
locations.address: Plaça de l'Olivar, s/n, 07002 Palma, Illes Balears, Spain

references.note: Operating since the 1950s; Balearic cheeses, garlic, olives, local salts; Mercat Negre (seafood small plates) and Buades (ibérico, charcuterie, cheeses). Busy with visitors and locals.

locations.name: Botànic
locations.description: The restaurant of Can Bordoy Grand House (the 16th-century-mansion hotel already on your list) — plant-forward international cooking served in the mansion's garden: salted tomato with Mallorcan-prawn carpaccio, spicy mango gazpacho, and a wine list with homegrown labels. Candlelit and romantic by night, an elegant garden lunch by day.
locations.address: Carrer del Forn de la Glòria, 14, 07012 Palma, Illes Balears, Spain

references.note: 16th-century mansion garden setting; salted tomato with Mallorcan-prawn carpaccio, spicy mango gazpacho; thoughtful wine list with homegrown labels. Romantic candlelit evenings or Mediterranean lunch.

locations.name: Aromata
locations.description: Andreu Genestra's approachable fine-dining room — suckling pig with ensaïmada in ham-citrus sauce, squid-aioli sandwiches, market fish with tumbet. Strong-value weekday lunch menus; dinner tasting from €75. Note: relocated in October 2024 from the Concepció mansion to the HM Palma Blanc hotel on Carrer de Ramon y Cajal — the Infatuation's old-mansion framing describes the previous location.
locations.address: Carrer de Ramon y Cajal, 12, 07011 Palma, Illes Balears, Spain

references.note: One of the island's top chefs; suckling pig with ensaïmada in ham-citrus sauce, squid-aioli sandwiches, tumbet; weekday lunch menus at strong value, dinner tasting from €75. (Address updated: moved to HM Palma Blanc, Ramon y Cajal 12, in Oct 2024.)

locations.name: Fornet de la Soca
locations.description: Heritage bakery on Plaça de Weyler reviving recipes from Mallorcan homes and monasteries — sugar-topped ensaïmades (chocolate, cream, even a rare plaited-potato version), coca with roasted peppers, fig cupcakes. Always crowded, takeaway-only with plaza seating nearby: the ensaïmada stop of any Palma day, and the box to carry home.
locations.address: Plaça de Weyler, 9, 07001 Palma, Illes Balears, Spain

references.note: Recipes from local homes and monasteries; ensaïmades (classic, chocolate, cream, rare plaited potato), coca with roasted peppers, fig cupcakes. Always crowded; takeaway with nearby plaza seating.

locations.name: Fera
locations.description: Restored city-center mansion with a cobble-floored garden of orange and palm trees — Austrian chef Simon Petutschnig fuses Mallorcan produce with pan-Asian flavors: beets with ponzu and goat cheese, wagyu carpaccio in tom kha gai. Vegetarian tasting menus and à-la-carte lunches make it flexible for either a special occasion or a smart midday meal.
locations.address: C/ de la Concepció, 4, 07012 Palma, Illes Balears, Spain

references.note: Restored mansion, cobble-floored garden with orange and palm trees; Mallorcan produce with pan-Asian flavors (beets with ponzu, polenta with artichoke and sansho, wagyu carpaccio in tom kha gai); vegetarian tasting menus; lunch à la carte.

locations.tags: fusion, garden, mansion, palma, tasting-menu, vegetarian-friendly

locations.name: La Vieja
locations.description: Colorful, mural-covered Canarian spot in Sa Gerreria — papas arrugadas served in volcanic-stone bowls with two mojo sauces, one blended tableside with coriander. Sunny-terrace afternoon tapas, and a change of pace from the Mallorcan rotation.
locations.address: Plaça de Sant Antoni, 07002 Palma, Illes Balears, Spain

references.note: Papas arrugadas in volcanic-stone bowls with two mojos (one blended tableside); colorful murals; afternoon tapas on a sunny terrace.

locations.name: Santa Catalina Market
locations.description: Palma's classic produce market in Santa Catalina — SheerLuxe rated it 5/5 for the freshest produce on the island, and the Infatuation names its eat-in stars: Bar Joan Frau for breakfast llonguets and a proper variat, and Arume's market sushi bar for dim sum with langoustines. Standing-room counters, walk-ins only; the surrounding blocks hold the neighborhood's restaurant cluster (El Perrito, Stagier, Vandal, Xoriguer).
locations.address: Plaça de la Navegació, s/n, 07013 Palma, Illes Balears, Spain

references.note: Guide entry #1: classic Spanish market, metallic counters, local crowd; Bar Joan Frau (breakfast sandwiches, variat) and Arume sushi bar (dim sum with langoustines, oxtail). Standing room; walk-ins.

locations.name: La Rosa Vermutería
locations.description: Wildly popular vermouth bar on Carrer de la Rosa — house vermouth, a giant tortilla pintxo, Mallorcan pork sausages, pork cheeks braised in vermouth, rice with smoked mushrooms. The Infatuation says it's 'worth waiting in line'; reserve if you can. The Palma counterpart of the vermut-hour ritual.
locations.address: Carrer de la Rosa, 5, 07003 Palma, Illes Balears, Spain

references.note: 'Worth waiting in line' for the house vermouth and giant tortilla pintxo; platters of Mallorcan pork sausages, croquettes, pork cheeks in vermouth, rice with smoked mushrooms. Reservations recommended.

locations.name: Stagier
locations.description: Tiny, romantic Chilean-Peruvian fusion room in Santa Catalina — chimichurri-butter sourdough, lobster-filled avocado rolls. The Infatuation calls it 'the most exciting addition to the neighborhood in recent years' and warns to book weeks ahead — treat it like a mini book-asap for the Palma nights.
locations.address: Carrer d'Espartero, 11, 07014 Palma, Illes Balears, Spain

references.note: 'The most exciting addition in recent years' to Santa Catalina — chimichurri-butter sourdough, lobster-filled avocado rolls. Date-night destination; book weeks ahead.

locations.tags: book-asap, date-night, fusion, intimate, palma, romantic

locations.name: Bar La Sang
locations.description: A brilliant natural-wine bar pouring earthy Mallorcan reds and small-producer Spanish bottles alongside tapas like burrata-anchovy tostadas — intimate, wine-geek-friendly, indoor-outdoor. ⚠️ The Infatuation (May 2026) lists it as temporarily closed — check before going.
locations.address: Carrer d'Antoni Frontera, 22, 07004 Palma, Illes Balears, Spain

references.note: Natural-wine focus (Mallorcan reds, Catalan whites, small Spanish producers); burrata-anchovy tostadas; cool and laid-back. Listed as TEMPORARILY CLOSED as of this guide — verify before visiting.

locations.tags: natural-wine, palma, small-producers, tapas, temporarily-closed, wine-geek

locations.name: Marc Fosh
locations.description: 1-Michelin-star tasting menus in a 17th-century monastery on Carrer de la Missió — watermelon soup with dill-cucumber spheres, caviar on crumpets, pea-sardine tartlets, farm-sourced throughout. The Infatuation calls it 'probably the most famous destination restaurant in Palma'; the €69 lunch menu is the value move vs. dinner from €139.
locations.address: Carrer de la Missió, 7A, 07003 Palma, Illes Balears, Spain

references.note: 'Probably the most famous destination restaurant in Palma' — 17th-century monastery; lunch from €69, dinner from €139; watermelon soup with dill-cucumber spheres, caviar on crumpets.

locations.name: Bodega La Rambla
locations.description: Old-school tavern going since the 1940s at Plaça des Patins — the classic place for the Mallorcan variat: one platter of ensaladilla, fried squid, octopus fritters, mushrooms, and cod (a vegetarian version exists too). Standing bar up front, sit-down room behind.
locations.address: Via Roma, 6, 07012 Palma, Illes Balears, Spain

references.note: Since the 1940s; house variat with ensaladilla, fried squid, octopus fritters, mushrooms, cod; vegetarian variat available. Beloved local spot.

locations.name: El Perrito
locations.description: Santa Catalina's benchmark brunch café overlooking the market — llonguets (Mallorcan bread rolls) with Mahón cheese or cured ham and tomato, fresh island ingredients throughout. 'So good they opened a second location'; streetside tables go fast, regulars eat at the bar.
locations.address: Carrer d'Anníbal, 20, 07013 Palma, Illes Balears, Spain

references.note: Llonguet with Mahón cheese or cured ham and tomato; fresh island ingredients; 'so good they opened a second location.' Streetside tables popular.

locations.name: Toque de Queda
locations.description: Converted ancient bakery-deli on a sunny staircase street in old Palma — exceptional charcuterie and cheese boards with grapes and jams, plus Mediterranean tapas like roasted baby potatoes with paprika aioli and burrata with kale pesto. Unfussy, cava-friendly, with outdoor tables on the steps.
locations.address: Carrer de Can Cavalleria, 15B, 07012 Palma, Illes Balears, Spain

references.note: Converted ancient bakery and deli; exceptional charcuterie boards; roasted baby potatoes with paprika aioli, burrata salad with kale pesto; outdoor tables on the staircase street.

locations.name: El Camino
locations.description: A bustling, high-end tapas counter on Carrer dels Apuntadors from the team behind London's Barrafina — long bar, open kitchen, order-as-you-go: padrón peppers, fried zucchini flowers with goat cheese, individual tortillas, local Mallorcan wines. Third independent source to endorse it (Manus master list, wine-bar roundup, and now the Infatuation); Bar Día is a few doors down for the no-frills counterpart.
locations.address: Carrer dels Apuntadors, 07012 Palma, Illes Balears, Spain

references.note: Barrafina-team tapas bar, long counter regularly packed; padrón peppers, fried zucchini flowers with goat cheese, individual tortillas, local wines. Order as you go.

locations.name: Vandal
locations.description: Nighttime-only lounge in Santa Catalina pairing playful small plates with cocktails — a ceviche cone with coconut foam, croquettes of maize, pork and huitlacoche. The Infatuation: it 'basically demands you have a great time.' Book ahead for weekends; the fun, sceney late-dinner slot of the Palma stretch.
locations.address: Plaça del Progrés, 9, 07013 Palma, Illes Balears, Spain

references.note: Nighttime-only lounge; ceviche–coconut-foam cone, croquettes with maize, pork, huitlacoche; cocktail pairings. 'Basically demands you have a great time.' Book ahead for weekends.

locations.tags: cocktails, late-night, nightlife, palma, sceney, tapas

locations.name: DINS Santi Taura
locations.description: 1-Michelin-star, 11-course tasting menu devoted purely to Mallorcan heritage recipes — razorfish with fried eggs, prawns with sobrassada, served on handmade ceramics inside a luxury hotel near the cathedral. The Infatuation calls it the restaurant 'leading the way' in Palma fine dining; the chef's-table bar seats are the move.
locations.address: Plaça de Llorenç Villalonga, 4, 07001 Palma, Illes Balears, Spain

references.note: 'Leading the way' in Palma's fine-dining scene — 11-course farm-to-table Mallorcan heritage menu; razorfish with fried eggs, prawns with sobrassada; handmade ceramic crockery; chef's table at the bar.

locations.tags: chefs-table, fine-dining, mallorcan, michelin-star, palma, tasting-menu
